transcript: Speaker A: Hello sir, my husband is not available right now. Can I take a message? I will ask him to call you back. Speaker B: अरे रितु! तुमने इतनी अच्छी इंग्लिश बोलना कहाँ से सीखी? [Hey Ritu! Then download the English Seekho app today. If you also want to improve your English, download the English Seekho app now. Here you get an English Seekho coach, who is available for you 24 hours. No matter how many mistakes you make, they will never judge you. Click on the install button and download the English Seekho app now.] Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
